title: Harbor
description: Harbor 2.15.4 (chart 1.19.4): core, registry, jobservice, trivy, exporter; PostgreSQL harbor-db (CloudNativePG). Curated from the Harbor metrics documentation, the upstream example dashboard (imported as 'Harbor (official)') and the harbor-mixin alerts. Sources: docs/dashboards/security.md

panels.description: How to read this dashboard.

options.content:
### Harbor: container image and Helm chart registry
**What it does here.** Harbor 2.15.4 (chart 1.19.4) at `harbor.<domain>`: **core** (API, auth via Keycloak OIDC, token service), **registry** (distribution, images on a `local-path` volume) + registryctl, **jobservice** (scans, GC, retention, replication; queue in the internal Redis), **trivy** (vulnerability scanner), **portal** (UI), **exporter** (reads the database and Redis for the project/queue metrics). PostgreSQL is the CloudNativePG cluster `harbor-db`.

**Healthy looks like:** every component UP, API 4xx/5xx well under 15 %, job queues at 0 between scans/GC, registry storage p99 low, memory below limits. `harbor_task_concurrency` and the jobservice task metrics only exist while/after jobs run.

**When something is red:** `kubectl --context k8s01 -n harbor get pods`; logs of the component that is DOWN; database → **CloudNativePG** dashboard (Databases folder, cluster `harbor-db`). Not scraped: Redis (no exporter in the chart; its liveness is `harbor_up{component="redis"}`) and Trivy (its /metrics has only Go runtime metrics). Docs: [Harbor metrics](https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/), `docs/dashboards/security.md`.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: Components (harbor_up)
panels.description: Running status of every Harbor component as seen by the exporter (core, database, jobservice, portal, redis, registry, registryctl, trivy). Any DOWN for 5 min fires HarborComponentStatus (harbor-mixin (grafana/jsonnet-libs @ dfd854fa, https://github.com/grafana/jsonnet-libs/tree/dfd854fa671fba95fb6dc915e022715b6db043ce/harbor-mixin)). Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Overall health
panels.description: harbor_health from the exporter (1 = Harbor /api/v2.0/health reports healthy). Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Version / auth
panels.description: harbor_system_info labels: running version and authentication mode (oidc_auth = Keycloak). Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Core API 4xx/5xx (5m)
panels.description: Share of core API requests answered 4xx/5xx over 5 min, the HarborHighErrorRate expression: red at the mixin's 15 % (harbor-mixin (grafana/jsonnet-libs @ dfd854fa, https://github.com/grafana/jsonnet-libs/tree/dfd854fa671fba95fb6dc915e022715b6db043ce/harbor-mixin)). Docker login challenges (401) count here, so a few % is normal.

panels.title: Metrics targets up
panels.description: Scrape targets of the chart ServiceMonitor (core, exporter, jobservice, registry: 4 expected) that answer. Source: Prometheus up.

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: harbor_statistics_total_project_amount: projects (public + private). Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Repositories
panels.description: harbor_statistics_total_repo_amount: repositories in all projects. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Artifacts
panels.description: Sum of harbor_project_artifact_total (images, charts, other OCI artifacts) over all projects. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: harbor_statistics_total_storage_consumption: bytes of all artifacts as Harbor accounts them (deduplicated blobs). The local-path volume itself is on the node disk (node dashboards). Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Pulls (all time)
panels.description: Sum of harbor_artifact_pulled: pull count stored in the database (a gauge that only grows). Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Private projects
panels.description: harbor_statistics_private_project_amount: projects that need authentication to pull. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: One row per project: repositories, members, artifacts pulled, storage used and quota (-1 = unlimited, the default here). Usage above a set quota for 15 min fires HarborProjectQuataExceeded (harbor-mixin (grafana/jsonnet-libs @ dfd854fa, https://github.com/grafana/jsonnet-libs/tree/dfd854fa671fba95fb6dc915e022715b6db043ce/harbor-mixin)). Source: exporter metrics, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Requests by operation
panels.description: Core API requests/s by Harbor API operationId (`unknown` = legacy and /v2 proxy endpoints); the GetPing (liveness probe) and GetHealth (exporter) calls are left out. Source: harbor_core_http_request_total, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Responses by status code
panels.description: Core API requests/s by HTTP code, probes included. 401 comes from unauthenticated registry/API calls (docker login challenge); 5xx should be 0. Source: harbor_core_http_request_total, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Latency p99 by operation
panels.description: 99th percentile per operation from the core summary harbor_core_http_request_duration_seconds (client-side quantiles over a sliding window, so they cannot be aggregated; max over pods). The upstream dashboard plots quantile 0.9 (Harbor 2.15.4 contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json (https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/blob/v2.15.4/contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json)). Probes left out.

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: harbor_core_http_inflight_requests: requests being served by core right now. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Registry requests by handler and code
panels.description: Requests/s served by the registry (distribution) by handler (base, blob, blob_upload, manifest, tags…) and code. Pushes show as blob_upload/manifest PUT, pulls as blob/manifest GET. Source: registry_http_requests_total, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Registry latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Registry request duration from the histogram registry_http_request_duration_seconds, all handlers. The upstream dashboard plots p90 over 10m (Harbor 2.15.4 contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json (https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/blob/v2.15.4/contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json)). Large blob transfers are slow by nature: compare with request sizes.

panels.title: Storage action latency p99
panels.description: Time the registry spends in its storage driver (filesystem on local-path) per action (Stat, GetContent, Writer, Move…). A rise points at the node disk. Source: registry_storage_action_seconds, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Bytes pushed / pulled
panels.description: Request body bytes/s (pushes) and response body bytes/s (pulls) of the registry, from the _sum of registry_http_request_size_bytes / registry_http_response_size_bytes. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Blob descriptor cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits / requests of the registry's blob descriptor cache (Redis), from registry_storage_cache_total{type}. Gaps = no lookups in the window. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Registry in-flight requests
panels.description: registry_http_in_flight_requests by handler. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Queue size by job type
panels.description: Jobs waiting in the jobservice Redis queue per type (IMAGE_SCAN, GARBAGE_COLLECTION, RETENTION, …), read by the exporter. Should drain to 0; a type that stays > 0 has no worker progress. Source: harbor_task_queue_size, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Queue latency by job type
panels.description: How long ago the next job of each type was enqueued (age of the oldest waiting job). Source: harbor_task_queue_latency, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

panels.title: Running and scheduled jobs
panels.description: harbor_task_concurrency: jobs running per type on the worker pool (series exist only while jobs run); harbor_task_scheduled_total: periodic/scheduled jobs registered. Same queries as the upstream JobService row (Harbor 2.15.4 contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json (https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/blob/v2.15.4/contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json)).

panels.title: Jobs processed by type and status
panels.description: Jobs finished per type and status (Success, Error, Stopped) in each interval. Series appear after the first job of a type since the jobservice pod started. Source: harbor_jobservice_task_total, https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

defaults.noValue: no job finished since jobservice start

panels.title: Average job duration by type
panels.description: Mean processing time per job type over 1 h from the summary harbor_jobservice_task_process_time_seconds (_sum / _count). Empty until jobs run. Source: https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/

defaults.noValue: no job finished since jobservice start

panels.title: Memory: working set vs limit
panels.description: cAdvisor working set per container of the harbor namespace (core, registry, registryctl, jobservice, trivy, redis, portal, exporter, postgres) and its memory limit (kube-state-metrics). OOMKill happens at the limit.

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: cAdvisor CPU cores used per container. Trivy spikes during scans (and DB updates), registry during pushes/pulls.
